message: 秘境探索採集ツアー

name: Lolotte
message: 「Presideeeent! Over heeeere.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huff, huff, sorry to keep you waiting~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, Azel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You remember that matter the chairwoman asked us to handle, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right, about Azel. We were so busy with KiraFes that it completely got put on the back burner.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It has been quite a while.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying? You haven't even been properly shown around this academy yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not head outside the academy for a change of pace?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is a brilliant idea!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, considering she is the type to get lost even in her own backyard... she might end up sobbing in anxiety.」

name: Azel
message: 「Nonsense.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so! As a fellow exchange student and your senior as a foreigner here, I shall take it upon myself to show you around!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, aren't you just a returnee, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You usually let it slide, so please don't nitpick only at times like this.」

name: Azel
message: 「Unnecessary.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Besides, Azel, you came here because you wanted to learn more about this world, didn't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「No.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then what was your reason?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「See, I knew it. There is no point getting embarrassed about that.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「So you were embarrassed~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And with that settled, let's go on an expedition together♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Look, look! I can see the ship!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Where are you looking?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aha~~. So you've fallen in love with the President, haven't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today is just the thing for Azel-san, then. You see, when night falls, parks apparently become wildly popular hotspots for love to blossom.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so... I had no idea...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. Not that I've ever caught anyone in the act, though.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me today's exploration is...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Art of Exploring Uncharted Adult Territory.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...\s03」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, are you sure it's okay for you to be out that late...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As long as it's for Student Council activities, Jiiya will allow it, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Can you really call that a Student Council activity...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This too is an unavoidable path we must walk in order to make Azel-san an adult!」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um, hey. About what she said earlier about you being in love with me--」

name: Azel
message: 「That's not happening.」

name: Synn
message: 「...Thought so.」
For some reason, I felt relieved.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So excited...!」
Lolotte leans forward, gazing out at the sea.

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel? You've been in the exact same position for a while now, are you okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「No problem.」
I'm impressed those two can stand in the exact same spot for so long.
Especially Azel, who hasn't moved a muscle.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san! Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「Shut up.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's about to happen, so please watch closely!」

name: Synn
message: 「What is.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You'll just have to see for yourself♪ According to my research, it should be any moment now...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah! Look! Azel-san, please look!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa~~」
The dazzling sun sinks toward the horizon, the sunset dyeing the ocean orange.
The setting sun reflected on the water's surface swayed with the ripples of the sea.
Azel gazed intently at the sight without saying a word.
Her reaction was the same as usual, yet her eyes were not wandering elsewhere.

name: Azel
message: 「It's pretty, isn't it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Right, right! This is truly what it means to have one's soul cleansed.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph, cleansing one's soul...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's an idiom. Jeez, Azel-san, you really are so ignorant.」

name: Azel
message: 「What was that...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, ignorance is a good thing. Because it means you still have the room to learn new things and remember them properly.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well? Did you record it firmly in the diary of your heart?」

name: Azel
message: 「If my soul gets cleansed...」

name: Azel
message: 「There's no way I could possibly remember it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please stop splitting hairs. Can't you just accept that something pretty is pretty?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san, do you like pretty scenery like this?」
She averts her gaze.

name: Lolotte
message: 「So you do like it!」

name: Azel
message: 「I didn't say anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel...?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Ngh, I-I'm going home!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehhh~~」

name: Azel
message: 「Not interested.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so? Well then, let's head somewhere with an even more wonderful view!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And with that, I pass the baton to Mr. President.\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Out of ideas, huh.\s02」
Still, the only thing left is a spot where you can get a good view of the meteors, though...

name: Azel
message: 「I'm good.」

name: Azel
message: 「Here is fine.」
Saying that, Azel sat hugging her knees, gazing steadily at the setting sun.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well then. Badump, badump... It's almost about time, but... Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... Zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「She's asleep...」
Azel stands up abruptly.

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm going home.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh...! You're not going to stay and watch the main event tonight...?」
Azel silently pointed at us.

name: Azel
message: 「Cruising spot.」

name: Azel
message: 「Adult exploration of uncharted territory.」

name: Synn
message: 「Of Lolotte!?」

name: Azel
message: 「How impure.」

name: Synn
message: 「Pfft! Isn't that a completely baseless accusation!」
Ignoring what I had to say, Azel was looking up at the sky.

name: Azel
message: 「It's pretty, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Azel
message: 「However...」

name: Azel
message: 「I can't keep it in my heart.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz... Azel-saaan. Mumble mumble...」
Still holding Lolotte in my arms, there was no way I could move right away.
All I could do was stand there and watch Azel walk away.

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh... What a mysterious girl.」
I look up at the same sky Azel had been gazing at.

name: Synn
message: 「Hehe, though Lolotte is mysterious in a different way.」
She ran all over the place just to make Azel happy, and ended up never getting to do her own exploring.
In my arms, she is breathing softly and peacefully in her sleep.
I somehow felt bad about waking her up.
Lolotte, who works so hard for someone else's sake. Lolotte, who is a bit reckless and rash.
Lately, I've come to feel that being together with an energetic girl like Lolotte is actually fun.

name: Synn
message: 「Still...」
Gradually, couples of men and women begin appearing here and there.
Just as the rumors said, lovers show up to gaze at the harbor's night view and the shooting stars.
Naturally, they are nestled just as close to one another as the two of us are.
Does that mean Lolotte and I look the exact same way to them... thump-thump.

name: Synn
message: 「Hwah!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have come to pick you up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah! Oh! Keeping her out this late... I'm sorry for making you worry.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Not at all. Knowing that you are by her side, Chairman, puts my mind at ease.」
And yet, why are you pointing a gun at me!?

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Lolotte. Riesling-san is here to pick you up~」

name: Riesling
message: 「Milady. We are at your long-awaited lovers' spot.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I can't eat another bitee~~ eheh... zzz.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, she's completely out...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Excuse me.」
She slips an arm around Lolotte's shoulders and lifts her up in a princess carry.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufuu... Presideent... I'm surprisingly heavy, you knoow...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because my boobs got big just like Senpai's~~ zzz, zzz.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... ngh, what kind of sleep-talking is that...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's true, you knoow... Then, do you wanna try touching them~~?」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Just what on earth were you doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm telling you, I wasn't doing anything--!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Please be sure to exercise proper restraint.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah! I-I got it...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, please excuse me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Goodbyeee~~」
Well then, I should head home too....
